notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. AI router fallback chain: the Sidekick assistant automatically retries a user-configured backup model on rate limits (429), server errors (5xx) and timeouts, with fail-closed auth handling (401/403 never cascade) and a token budget, all visible in Developer Tools → Routing log. Also keeps Material 3 dynamic color (Monet), a draggable floating Sidekick button, in-app update, Telegram bot, Sidekick assistant with background research, Eco Mode (Token Saver), Developer Tools, session auto-recovery, release & signing, optional server sync, reproducible build + SBOM. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
